Luxury Renovation FAQ

Useful answers before you begin.

What makes a renovation a luxury renovation?

Luxury work typically involves highly coordinated design, premium materials, custom fabrication and a greater level of precision in installation and finishing.

Can you work with my designer?

Yes. VR Plus Construction can collaborate with the homeowner’s architect, interior designer and engineering consultants.

Do you provide custom millwork?

Custom millwork can be included and coordinated with qualified fabricators as part of the renovation scope.
